_comment: Drives src/_includes/tool-hero.liquid, keyed by page.url. A page that includes the hero MUST NOT keep its own <h1>, since the hero renders it. Pages with no entry here render no hero at all, which is how the immersive tools (word-clock, focus-timer, private-line) and the games stay untouched.

/accessible-palette-generator/.title: Accessible palette generator
/accessible-palette-generator/.subtitle: Pick one colour and get eleven steps that each hit a known WCAG contrast ratio, with every possible pair checked for you.

/dyslexia-font-tester/.title: Dyslexia font tester
/dyslexia-font-tester/.subtitle: Paste your own text and read it in four typefaces at once, with the spacing controls that usually matter more than the typeface does.

/contrast-checker/.title: Colour contrast checker
/contrast-checker/.subtitle: Check text, links and backgrounds against WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA in real time, with live samples at every size and a whole-palette matrix.

/chrome-extension-icon-generator/.title: Extension icon resizer
/chrome-extension-icon-generator/.subtitle: Upload one 1024px square and get all nine icon sizes a Chrome extension needs, resized right here in your browser.

/meta-tags/.title: Meta tags generator
/meta-tags/.subtitle: Fill in four fields, see exactly how your page will look on Google, Facebook and X, then copy one ready-made block.

/text-converter/.title: Text case converter
/text-converter/.subtitle: Paste anything and switch it between sentence case, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and the rest.

/meta-images/.title: Photo metadata remover
/meta-images/.subtitle: Drop in a photo to see what it quietly reveals, from location and date to camera model, then download a clean copy that says nothing.

/meta-videos/.title: Video metadata remover
/meta-videos/.subtitle: See the GPS location, device and timestamps hiding inside your videos, then download a copy with all of it stripped out.

/secret-message-image-encoder/.title: Hide text in images
/secret-message-image-encoder/.subtitle: Tuck a secret message inside an ordinary picture with steganography, then decode it later. Nothing ever leaves your browser.

/email-signature-generator/.title: Email signature maker
/email-signature-generator/.subtitle: Build an HTML signature with photos and social icons, preview it live, then paste it straight into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail.

/emoji/.title: Emoji search
/emoji/.subtitle: Search thousands of emoji by name, browse by category, and copy any of them with a single click.

/mp3-transcript/.title: MP3 to transcript
/mp3-transcript/.subtitle: Turn audio into text using Chrome's built-in AI, for meetings, interviews and voice notes. The file never leaves your machine.

/receipt-generator/.title: Receipt generator
/receipt-generator/.subtitle: Create a thermal-style replacement receipt for bookkeeping, with barcode, tax and discount maths and an 80mm PDF download.

/timezone-converter/.title: Time zone converter
/timezone-converter/.subtitle: Pick a city and see the local time there, how far ahead or behind they are, and whether it is a decent hour to call.

/flip/.title: Flip a coin
/flip/.subtitle: Heads or tails in one click, with a spinning coin and a running tally of every flip.

/vibe-check/.title: Vibe Check
/vibe-check/.subtitle: Guess the day's vibe from four emoji clues. Four tries, everyone gets the same puzzle, and a new one lands at midnight.

/tweet-cleanup/.title: Delete your retweets, likes and tweets
/tweet-cleanup/.subtitle: Pick what you want gone and copy a script to run in your own browser. No app, nothing signs into your account, nothing is sent to us.
